enunciado: Run a depth-first search on the graph from vertex 0 in two ways: recursively and with an explicit stack. Show both orders and explain why they may differ.
objetivos: Replace recursion with an explicit stack
pistas: Recursive DFS: visit the vertex and recurse into each unvisited neighbor.
With a stack: push neighbors in reverse order to mimic the recursive order.
In the stack version a vertex can be pushed twice: check it when popping.
